test_title: PYST 46: SSC GD Constable - English (Held on: 3rd December 2021 Shift 3)
subject: english
question: **Select the INCORRECTLY spelt word.**
solution:
The erroneous spelling is: Bitray.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** 

__
 
• The correct spelling should be 'Betray'.
 
• Betray means to hurt somebody who trusts you, especially by not being loyal or faithful to him/her.
 
 
• **Example -** *If you take the money you’ll **betray **her trust.*
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is option 3 which is incorrectly spelt.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** 

 
• Specific means detailed or exact.
 
• Reverse means to put something in the opposite position to normal or to how it was before.
 
• Resist means to try to stop something from happening or to stop somebody from doing something.
